Agent(s) Subject to Criteria: Tarpeyo DR capsule AE, CC, QL

Criteria for Approval: ● Patient has a biopsy-confirmed diagnosis of primary immunoglobulin A nephropathy (IgAN); AND
● Patient is at least 18 years of age; AND
● Patient has an eGFR of 35–90 mL/min/1.73 m²; AND
● Patient has persistent proteinuria defined as Urine Protein-to-Creatinine Ratio (UPCR) ≥0.8 g/g or proteinuria ≥1 g/day despite optimized supportive care; AND

● Patient is receiving a stable dose of maximally tolerated renin-angiotensin system (RAS) inhibitor therapy (ACE inhibitor or ARB) for at least 12 weeks, unless documented contraindication or intolerance; AND
● Patient does not have nephrotic syndrome, other glomerulopathies, or recent treatment with systemic immunosuppressive medications; AND
● Patient does not have severe hepatic impairment (Child-Pugh Class C)
● Patient will avoid concomitant therapy with strong CYP3A4 inhibitors (e.g. ketoconazole, itraconazole, ritonavir, indinavir, saquinavir, erythromycin, and cyclosporine); AND
● Provider attests that patient has been counseled to avoid ingestion of grapefruit juice while on Tarpeyo therapy; AND

Agent(s) Subject to Criteria: ● Provider attests that the patient will be monitored for signs of adrenal insufficiency during and after a 2-week taper at the end of Tarpeyo therapy (9 months of therapy); AND

Criteria for Approval:
• Prescribed by or in consultation with a nephrologist.

Age Limit: ≥ 3 years
Quantity Limit: 16 mg once daily (four 4-mg capsules)
